Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.19521

Status: **open** according to the source (as of November 2024). “Based on many computations with tropical linear spaces, the third author made the following conjecture, which is still open:”
source_name: Alex Fink, Kris Shaw and David E Speyer, “The omega invariant of a matroid”, arXiv:2411.19521 (2026).
statement: Let $M$ be a matroid, and let $g_M(t)\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ be the covaluative matroid invariant described in the paper. **Nonnegativity conjecture for $g_M(t)$.** For any matroid $M$, the coefficients of $g_M(t)$ are nonnegative. This conjecture would imply the f-vector conjecture for matroidal decompositions of uniform matroids; its resolution is not established in the supplied text.
title: Nonnegativity conjecture for the matroid polynomial g-invariant
